:::{#def-list-decodable-code}
#### List-decodable code

Let $C$ be a [block code](error-correcting-codes.qmd#def-block-code) of length $n$ over the alphabet $\codealph$,
and let $e \ge 0$ and $L \ge 1$ be integers.
The code $C$ is **$(e, L)$-list-decodable** if every received word $r \in \codealph^n$
has at most $L$ codewords $c$ with $\hamdist{c}{r} \le e$.
**List decoding** a received word $r$ means finding all of those codewords.

:::
